text: vv shall measure a project's progress only by what has been verified.
rationale: Progress that is said rather than shown is not progress.

text: vv shall load and check a requirement list.
load shall report every malformed id and each duplicated id once.
rationale: Ids are what everything else joins on.

text: load shall report unknown parents and every member of a parent cycle.
rationale: Status rolls up the tree; the tree must be one.

text: load shall report leaves with an unknown method, and mandatory leaves without acceptance criteria, sorted by id then code.
rationale: A leaf is where verification happens.

text: lint shall flag placeholder words, vague words, the slashed and-or, and mandatory text without the word shall.
rationale: Wording nobody can test cannot be verified.

text: vv shall trace requirements to the checks that verify them and the artifacts that implement them.
vv shall derive each requirement's status from dated evidence.
A leaf's status shall follow the latest result of each of its checks.
rationale: A fixed failure counts once it passes, not before.

text: Status shall ignore evidence dated after the as-of date.
rationale: Reports must be reproducible for any past date.

text: A parent's status shall roll up from its mandatory children, or from all of them when none is mandatory.
coverage shall count leaves by status and give the verified ratio.
vv shall track technical performance measures against their thresholds.
tpm shall give the current value, margin, status and objective as of a date.
tpm shall give the least-squares slope per day.
tpm shall project the first date the fitted line crosses the threshold.
acceptance: T-M4-BREACH passes, including a line that lands exactly on the threshold.
rationale: Warning before the breach is the point of a TPM.

text: vv shall compute earned value with value earned only by verified requirements.
earned shall compute planned value and actual cost as of a date.
earned shall credit a work package only with the share of its requirements that are verified.
acceptance: T-M5-EV passes, including hours spent with nothing verified earning zero.

text: earned shall compute earned schedule and the time-based schedule index.
rationale: SPI drifts to 1 at the end of a late project; SPIt does not.

text: The command line shall print one JSON report for a project folder.
The report shall hold problems, lint, coverage, orphans, status and measures, as of a given or derived date.
The report shall include earned value when the folder has a plan, and null when it has none.
The command line shall exit 1 with a one-line message on bad input.
rationale: A stack trace is not a message.

text: vv shall hold its own requirements and verify itself.
acceptance: T-M7-SELF passes and the report on this folder has no problems and coverage of at least 0.8.
